description:
i keep getting this message when i try to set up the mb mirror

The mirror was not finished
STOPPED
WORTH KNOWINGPMDA cannot work out where the mirror's compose checkout lives on the host. Inside this container it is /config/managed-runtime/musicbrainz-docker, but Docker creates the mirror's files on the host, where that path means nothing -- so the install would fail partway through with a folder you never named. Either put that folder somewhere PMDA already bind-mounts, or bind-mount it into PMDA at the same path on both sides (-v /config/managed-runtime/musicbrainz-docker:/config/managed-runtime/musicbrainz-docker) and point the field there.
